dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Oho! It looks like the humans were doing some sort of
work here...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Parece que os humanos estavam a fazer uma espécie de...
Trabalha aqui...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Perhaps we’ll find some trace of what happened to them.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>Or maybe the humans themselves will still be around!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Talvez encontremos algum vestígio do que lhes aconteceu.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>Ou talvez os próprios humanos ainda estejam por perto!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>As am I! The path seems to continue on ahead of us, so
let’s follow it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Assim como eu! O caminho parece continuar à nossa frente, então
Vamos segui-lo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Right! The path seems to continue on ahead of us, so let’s
follow it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Certo! O caminho parece continuar à nossa frente, então vamos
Sigam-no!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,6)>First of all, let’s go see what’s up ahead of us!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,6)>Primeiro de tudo, vamos ver o que está à nossa frente!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>Hrmmm... This is slightly more rugged terrain than we’ve
encountered up until now.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>Hrmmm... Este é um terreno ligeiramente mais acidentado do que nós temos
Encontrado até agora.

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,6)>And I don’t even see any Pokémon, let alone humans.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,6)>E eu nem sequer vejo nenhum Pokémon, muito menos humanos.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,1)>I just hope we can find something—even the smallest
trace of what happened to the humans.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,1)>Só espero que possamos encontrar alguma coisa - mesmo o menor
vestígios do que aconteceu aos humanos.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)>Now then... Where to begin, where to begin...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)>Agora, por onde começar, por onde começar...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)>Oh! Over there! Is that...a <$cdef(27)>PC?
<$voicel(1,5)>And the pile of rubble next to it looks like what’s left of a
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)>Ali! <$cdef(27)>PC?
<$voicel(1,5)>E a pilha de escombros ao lado dele parece com o que resta de um
<$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>That tells us that in the past, <$voicel(1,8)>this too was a town where
humans and Pokémon lived together!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Isso diz-nos que no passado, <$voicel(1,8)>Esta também era uma cidade onde
Os humanos e Pokémon viviam juntos!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>I don’t see anything else that looks like a clue, so let’s
start by checking out that <$cdef(27)>PC.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Come on, <$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Eu não vejo mais nada que se pareça com uma pista, então vamos
começar por verificar que <$cdef(27)>PC.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Vamos. <$cdef(27)>!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>First, let’s inspect that <$cdef(27)>PC</color>.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Primeiro, vamos inspecionar isso <$cdef(27)>PC</color>.

dialogues.en: The <$cdef(27)>PC </color>is not responding.
dialogues.pt_br: A <$cdef(27)>PC </color>Não está a responder.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,4)>Phew! That rugged path sure made for a challenging walk!
Now then, could you please examine that <$cdef(27)>PC?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,4)>Aquele caminho acidentado fez com que fosse um passeio desafiador!
Agora, então, você poderia por favor examinar que <$cdef(27)>PC?

dialogues.en: The <$cdef(27)>PC </color>is not responding.
dialogues.pt_br: A <$cdef(27)>PC </color>Não está a responder.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? Now that’s an odd-looking screen, if I ever saw one...
Is this a newer model or something?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>At any rate, try pushing some buttons and see
what happens.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Agora que é uma tela de aparência estranha, se eu já vi um ...
É um modelo mais novo ou algo assim?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>De qualquer forma, tente carregar em alguns botões e ver
O que acontece.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,7)>What?! Oh dear, this does put us in a pickle...
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,663)><$voicel(1,3)>If we can’t use the <$cdef(27)>PC, it will be much more difficult to
explore the area...<$motion(1,658)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,7)>Isto põe-nos em apuros...
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,663)><$voicel(1,3)>Se não podemos usar o <$cdef(27)>PC, será muito mais difícil
explorar a área...<$motion(1,658)>

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,7)>What?! Oh dear, this does put us in a pickle...
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,663)><$voicel(1,3)>If we can’t use the <$cdef(27)>PC, it will be much more difficult to
explore the area...<$motion(1,658)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,7)>Isto põe-nos em apuros...
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,663)><$voicel(1,3)>Se não podemos usar o <$cdef(27)>PC, será muito mais difícil
explorar a área...<$motion(1,658)>

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? What’s making that crackling sound?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Ohhh! Electricity!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>O que está fazendo esse barulho crepitante?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Eletricidade!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Oho! I’ve figured it out, <$cdef(27)>!
Machines
like
this
<$cdef(27)>PC
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>need
electricity
to work!<$motion(1,652)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Oho! Eu descobri, <$cdef(27)>!
Máquinas
como
isto
<$cdef(27)>PC
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>necessidade
electricidade
Ao trabalho!<$motion(1,652)>

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>If we can get the <$cdef(27)>PC over to that spot with the sparks of
electricity, <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>we should be able to use it properly!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>So, <$cdef(27)>...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Would you mind pushing this <$cdef(27)>PC over to the electricity?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Se conseguirmos o... <$cdef(27)>PC até aquele ponto com as faíscas de
electricidade, <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Devemos ser capazes de usá-lo corretamente!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>Então... <$cdef(27)>...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Importas-te de empurrar isto? <$cdef(27)>PC Para a electricidade?

dialogues.en: You push the <$cdef(27)>PC </color>as hard as you can!
dialogues.pt_br: Você empurra o <$cdef(27)>PC </color>O mais forte que puderes!

dialogues.en: But it’s so heavy that it won’t budge!
dialogues.pt_br: Mas é tão pesado que não se move!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>Hrmmm... It’s too heavy even for you, is it?
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,663)><$voicel(1,1)>I myself am altogether useless when it comes to feats of
strength, so...what should we do?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>Hrmmm... É muito pesado mesmo para você, não é?
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,663)><$voicel(1,1)>Eu sou completamente inútil quando se trata de feitos de
força, então... o que devemos fazer?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,6)>Why don’t we take a little break and think this over?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,6)>Por que não fazemos uma pausa e pensamos sobre isso?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Let’s take a little break and think this over.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Vamos fazer uma pequena pausa e pensar sobre isso.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Based on appearance, I’d say this area used to be a mine.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Baseado na aparência, eu diria que esta área costumava ser uma mina.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Back when there were humans here, they must have
worked together with a number of <$cdef(27)>Machoke <$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>to dig up
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(107)> and <$cdef(27)><$ifull(106)> and such.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Quando havia humanos aqui, eles devem ter...
trabalhou em conjunto com uma série de <$cdef(27)>Machoke <$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>para desenterrar
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(107)> e <$cdef(27)><$ifull(106)> e tal.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)><$cdef(27)>Machoke are Pokémon who really love training their
muscles, you see.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>They’re known for being buff, tough, and just all-around
extremely strong.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>I’ve heard they used that strength of theirs to help
humans with their manual labor.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)><$cdef(27)>Machoke são Pokémon que realmente amam treinar seus
Os músculos, vê.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Eles são conhecidos por ser buff, duro, e apenas tudo ao redor
extremamente forte.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Ouvi dizer que usaram essa força deles para ajudar
humanos com o seu trabalho manual.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>...Eureka!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>...Eureka!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Maybe we could entice a <$cdef(27)>Machoke to come back here <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,5)>by
making a suitable home!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>A Pokémon as strong as <$cdef(27)>Machoke could easily move <$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>even
that heavy <$cdef(27)>PC—I’m sure of it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Talvez possamos seduzir um <$cdef(27)>Machoke para voltar aqui. <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,5)>por
fazendo uma casa adequada!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Um Pokémon tão forte como <$cdef(27)>Machoke pode facilmente mover- se <$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,7)>mesmo
que pesado <$cdef(27)>PC—Tenho certeza disso!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Except...I don’t actually know what type of home a <$cdef(27)>Machoke
would live in.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Exceto ... eu não sei realmente que tipo de casa um <$cdef(27)>Machoke
viveria dentro.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Now that you mention it, I don’t actually know what type
of home a <$cdef(27)>Machoke would prefer.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Agora que você menciona isso, Eu não sei realmente que tipo
de casa a <$cdef(27)>Machoke Eu preferia.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>First off, do you suppose you could use your moves <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>to
make a few habitats other Pokémon might like?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Primeiro, achas que podias usar os teus movimentos? <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>para
fazer alguns habitats que outros Pokémon podem gostar?

dialogues.en:
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>If that causes a <$cdef(27)>Machoke to return, all the better! But even
if it doesn’t...
<$comeff(1,5)><$voicel(1,5)>Any new Pokémon we meet might <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>actually know a <$cdef(27)>Machoke!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Se isso causar uma <$cdef(27)>Machoke para voltar, tudo melhor!
se não o fizer...
<$comeff(1,5)><$voicel(1,5)>Qualquer novo Pokémon que encontremos pode ser... <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>realmente saber um <$cdef(27)>Machoke!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>So, let’s see... You could start by using <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)> to
restore some withered plants.
<$voicel(1,9)>And planting more tall grass with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(1)> would also
be a good idea!<$motion(1,654)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Então, vamos ver... Você poderia começar usando <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)> para
restaurar algumas plantas secas.
<$voicel(1,9)>E plantando mais grama alta com <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(1)> seria também
Seja uma boa ideia!<$motion(1,654)>

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Seeing as we want some help from a strong <$cdef(27)>Machoke, <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>why
don’t you start by making some Pokémon habitats?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Visto que queremos ajuda de um forte <$cdef(27)>Machoke, <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Porquê?
Não começa por criar alguns habitats Pokémon?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Let’s see... You could start by using <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)> to
restore some withered plants.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>And planting more tall grass with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(1)> would also
be a good idea!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Vejamos... Você pode começar usando <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)> para
restaurar algumas plantas secas.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>E plantando mais grama alta com <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(1)> seria também
Seja uma boa ideia!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>Hi there, <$cdef(27)>! Can I help you with
something?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Posso ajudá-lo?
Alguma coisa?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh, you know <$cdef(27)>Machoke too, huh? They’re just so cool,
don’t you think? <$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,10)>All that muscle!
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)><$cdef(27)>Machoke takes <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1526)> home from their jobsite when
they’re done working with ’em <$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>so they can train
whenever they want! <$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,6)>How cool is that?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh, tu sabe <$cdef(27)>Machoke também, huh? Eles são tão legais,
não acha? <$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,10)>Todo aquele músculo!
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)><$cdef(27)>Machoke toma <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1526)> casa de seu local de trabalho quando
eles estão cansados de trabalhar com 'em <$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>para que possam treinar
Quando quiserem! <$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,6)>Não é fixe?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,3)>What? Oh please, <$cdef(27)>Machoke isn’t so tiny!
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,8)>They’re much more muscular and impressive than little
old me!
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,6)><$cdef(27)>Machoke takes <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1526)> home from their jobsite
when they’re done working with ’em <$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>so they can train
whenever they want! <$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,6)>How cool is that?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,3)>O quê? <$cdef(27)>Machoke não é tão pequeno!
